protocol.claim_boundary: corrected frozen-fit descriptive association between heldout transport outcome and residual geometry; no channel causality, intervention, routing, adaptation, learning, or architectural claim
protocol.correction_reason: All channel transport maps and relationship predictors fit only paired base-order cue6-to-checkpoint train32 states. The prior descriptor artifact used heldout-order calibration and is unevaluable for descriptor association.
protocol.decision_rule: For each checkpoint and descriptor, report all seed-by-projection cells. A descriptor is nomination-eligible only if its predeclared direction separates pass from fail cells in at least three of four seeds. No descriptor is nominated if that criterion fails; associations remain descriptive even if it passes.
protocol.fitting_rule: Fit and save every channel transport map and relationship predictor using only paired base-order cue6-to-checkpoint train32. Apply all objects unchanged to paired heldout-order eval32. No heldout-order state, label, normalization, map, predictor, or threshold participates in fitting.
protocol.outcome_rule: Strict transport pass is the frozen tracking rule: heldout proper-orthogonal true-label R2 exceeds both matched conditional-shuffle and analytic latest-cue R2. It is not an independent observation from the tracking artifact.
